Agentizar el área legal

 - Threat modelling: Taking an attackers lens on what’s being built and understanding how it could be abused/targeted and being able to bring others on the journey through clear communication.

We’re looking for an operations specialist to help keep a real-time digital platform’s transaction workflows accurate, timely, and well documented. You’ll monitor processing activity, validate records against documented product terms and approved source information, support settlement and reconciliation, investigate exceptions, and coordinate escalations. Success requires careful execution, sound judgment, dependable handoffs, and the ability to learn internal systems and procedures.

Responsibilities:
• Build and oversee markets from idea through settlement, working with partners and internal teams to define the product, the data behind it, and the rules that govern it.

• Support daily exchange operations across production and test environments, including listing, scheduling, end-of-day processing, and settlement.

• Monitor live events and make sure markets open, close, and settle accurately and on time.

• Verify outcomes against authoritative sources. When sources disagree or a result changes, work out the right answer and document why.

• Investigate and resolve incidents under time pressure, understand the impact on customers and partners, and keep a full audit trail to enact automated improvements.

• Analyze trading and position data to support settlements, reviews, and partner requests.

• Partner with finance, legal, and development teams to escalate problems and collaborate on solutions.

• Work with developers to synchronize automation with settlement rules and the structure of the data we ingest.

• Use scripting and AI to automate repetitive work, stress-test rules, and build tools that make the team faster.

• Find gaps in our processes and close them. If something is done manually twice, it should probably be a tool.

Requirements:
• Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data in spreadsheets, databases, and operational tools.

• An instinct for edge cases. You think through every scenario before it becomes a problem.

• Strong research skills. You find the authoritative source, not just the first result.

• Clear, fast writing for both technical and non-technical audiences.

• A working understanding of APIs, data structures, and how data moves from a source into a system.

• Flexibility to move across disciplines and work effectively with internal teams and outside partners.

• Comfort in a mission-critical environment with live production stakes.

• A bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred.

Nice to Haves:
• 1–3 years in exchange operations, payment operations, derivatives, or a related field.

• Experience with SQL, Python, and navigating APIs

• Experience using AI to build tools, automate workflows, or speed up research.

• Familiarity with options, futures, binary contracts, or other exchange-traded products.

About etoro:

etoro is the platform where you can trade, invest, save, and spend. Founded in 2007 with the vision of a world where everyone can trade and invest in a simple and transparent way, we've built a regulated, Nasdaq-listed platform used by millions of people in 75 countries.

We believe there is power in shared knowledge. By combining the collective intelligence of our community with AI-powered tools, we've created a collaborative investment community designed to help you grow your knowledge and wealth.

On etoro, you can hold a range of traditional and innovative assets and choose how you invest: trade directly, invest in a portfolio, copy other investors, or invest with an AI agent. Visit our Media Centre for the latest news.

You can find out more about eToro here.

Role Summary

We are looking for an Junior-level Operations Specialist to join our Operations Back Office team in Limassol, Cyprus. A role that enables you to work with clients, help resolve complex requirements, and identify ways to improve operational efficiency in the team. You will also play a key role in helping us keep service quality high across CSAT, ticket volume and quality control.

Role location and working style:

This position is based in Limassol, Cyprus with an in-office and hybrid set up. Remote set up is not possible.

Key Responsibilities

• Handle client communications and inquiries through Salesforce

• Process withdrawals and answer customer inquiries for the DE lines

• Investigate customer and card details to understand and resolve each case

• Escalate complex or unresolved issues to the internal SME team

• Carry out day-to-day back-office operations tasks that keep client service running

• Contribute to team KPIs: CSAT, ticket volume and quality control

• React quickly and meet deadlines during incidents

Requirements

• An investigative, detail-oriented approach to reviewing customer and account information

• Strong multitasking and organization in a varied, constantly changing workload

• Ability to meet deadlines and stay composed under pressure during incidents

• Clear communication with customers in a service role

• Genuine motivation for operations and customer-service work

• Nice to have: familiarity with AI tools, or an open attitude towards using them

What we offer:

• Pension plan contributions and voluntary medical insurance

• Monthly meal and transport allowances

• 22 days annual leave plus 6 half-day recharge days

• etoro investment credit and home-office equipment

• Plus other benefits

Our Hiring Philosophy:

At etoro, AI is changing how we build, work and make decisions, and our hiring approach reflects that. We are building an AI-first organisation where people are encouraged to use AI thoughtfully.

That starts with how we hire. Throughout our recruitment process, we may use AI-enabled tools, including interview notetakers and other technologies that help us capture information accurately, improve consistency and create a better experience for candidates and interviewers. These tools support our feedback and assessment outcomes. Hiring decisions remain grounded in running fair and consistent interview processes, human judgement, critical thinking, and thorough evaluation of experience, ability and motivation that are aligned to our business and role requirements.

We also want candidates to be comfortable working with AI. Depending on the role, we may explore how you use AI tools in your day-to-day work, how you think about their opportunities and limitations, and how you would contribute to etoro’s continued AI build-out.

For us, being AI-first is not about replacing human judgement. It is about combining human expertise, creativity and accountability with technology that helps us do our best work and accelerate our growth. In the end, that's what we're hiring for: human insight, supercharged by AI.

At Exness, we are not just a leading trading broker—we’ve reimagined what it takes to be a leader. With 2,000+ people across 13 countries, we combine scale, care, and real tech to make trading better for over a million clients globally.

Recognised globally as a Best Place to Work, we’re a people-first company where long-term wins always matter more. As part of our team, you will shape the future of fintech with real technology, care, and purpose.

Why this role matters

As an AI Security Engineer, you will help build the security foundation that allows Exness to use LLMs, MCP integrations and autonomous agents safely at scale. You will focus on making sure AI systems can access data, tools and critical services without creating risks.

A big part of the role is turning security policies and threat models into real, testable technical controls. You will work on the centralized AI gateway, build guardrails and policy enforcement for LLM and agent workloads, secure MCP integrations and tool access, design sandboxing and isolation controls for agent execution, create a human-in-the-loop service approach with risk scoring for critical actions, set up Shadow AI detection and use AI to automate security processes. You will also audit and harden the systems that make up the AI platform, from the gateway to on-prem model serving.

We are looking for a hands-on senior engineer who is comfortable working across software development, infrastructure security, identity and LLM engineering, including fine-tuning and serving models. You should be able to take a security problem, design a practical solution, ship it to production and measure whether the control actually works.

The goal is to ensure that every AI interaction, whether started by an employee, a service or an autonomous agent, goes through controls that are enforced outside the model, observable, measurable and independently verifiable, without slowing down adoption

The role is based in our Limassol office, Cyprus. In case of relocation, we offer full relocation support for you and your family to make your move smooth and worry-free.

What you'll actually do

• Make the AI gateway the single controlled path to SaaS and on-prem models, and keep the platform behind it secure. This includes routing by data classification and security telemetry.

• Own the controls that govern what AI models receive, return, and can do through tools. Developing guardrails against prompt injection and data leakage, with fine-tuned classifiers where needed, and running the security review and onboarding of MCP servers on a least-privilege basis.

• Enable AI agents to do real work without exceeding the access of the users they act for. Design and implement the approach where agents run in isolation, with no more access than their user, and a human-in-the-loop service approach that sends critical actions for human approval based on risk scoring.

• Find AI use outside approved channels and bring it under control. This includes setting up the process and tooling to detect cases such as personal AI accounts, unregistered MCP servers and working with SOC and IT to block, replace, or onboard each one.

• Scale AI security works with AI itself, so that reviews and monitoring keep pace with adoption. This includes automating security review triage, assessments of MCP servers and AI tools, and analysis of AI security events on top of LLMs, agents, and fine-tuned on-prem models.

Who we’re looking for

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Security, Applied Mathematics / Machine Learning or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Certifications are not mandatory. Relevant examples: CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist), OSCP / OSWE, cloud security certifications. Courses or certifications in ML/LLM engineering or AI security are a plus.

• 5+ years in security engineering, platform / infrastructure engineering or backend development with a strong security focus.

• 2+ years of hands-on work with LLM / GenAI systems in production: building LLM-based services or agents, serving or fine-tuning models, or securing AI platforms.

• A track record of designing, shipping and operating production services and security tooling, not only reviews and audits.

• Experience in fintech, trading or other regulated, high-load environments is an advantage.

• LLM engineering and automation: solid practical understanding of how LLMs work and fail (context, sampling, tool calling, structured outputs, embeddings and RAG, agent loops, non-determinism); proven experience building LLM-powered automations or agents used in production, including evaluation (test sets, metrics, calibrated LLM-as-judge) and cost / latency control.

• Fine-tuning, deployment and optimization of models: hands-on fine-tuning of open-weight models with PyTorch and the Hugging Face stack (Transformers, PEFT, TRL), including dataset preparation and evaluation, e.g. for classification and detection tasks; serving and optimizing inference with vLLM (quantization, batching and KV-cache tuning, parallelism, GPU memory sizing, latency and throughput benchmarking) on Kubernetes.

• AI gateway: hands-on experience with LiteLLM, or equivalent depth with another AI gateway.

• Software engineering: strong Python or at least one systems language (Go, Rust, C/C++) for production services and APIs with tests, CI/CD and containerization; building and operating services with observability (metrics, logs, traces) and SLOs.

• Infrastructure security: Linux and Kubernetes security (RBAC, admission policies, Pod Security, NetworkPolicy, runtime isolation; network security (egress control, proxies, DNS, TLS / mTLS); identity (OAuth 2.1 / OIDC, JWT, token exchange, workload identity); secrets management; policy-as-code (OPA / Rego); hardening, vulnerability and patch management; IaC (Terraform, Helm, GitOps).

• AI security: practical knowledge of AI-specific attacks and controls (direct and indirect prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool poisoning, data exfiltration through agents, excessive agency, model and AI supply-chain risks); working knowledge of MCP and its authorization model, the OWASP Top 10 for LLM and for Agentic Applications, and MITRE ATLAS.

• Builder and ownership mindset: takes a capability from idea to production and operations, and owns the outcome rather than the task.

• Platform thinking: solves classes of problems with reusable controls and secure defaults instead of one-off fixes.

• Pragmatic, risk-based judgement: balances security, usability and delivery speed; avoids over-gating that pushes people towards Shadow AI.

• Autonomy: plans own work in a small team and raises blockers early.

What we offer along the way

• Competitive salary and annual performance bonus

• Full relocation support for you and your family — flights, housing, visas, and legal assistance included

• Top-tier health insurance with full family coverage — medical, dental, vision, mental health — plus life insurance for peace of mind

• Unlimited learning opportunities: external courses, English lessons, career and leadership development

• Education allowance covering school and kindergarten fees

• 21 working days of annual leave, plus public holidays and fully paid sick, maternity, and paternity leave

• Employee appreciation program: branded gifts, celebration budgets for weddings, newborns, and milestones

• “Get to know Team” trips — meet colleagues across our global hubs, along with company-wide offsites that raise the bar

• Employee share scheme — grow with us

• Branded MINI Cooper Countryman company car and private parking

• Free in-house sports clubs, Sanctum Club gym access, and jet skis

• Access to a Corporate doctor

• Exclusive discount program with cafes, gyms, and local services

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

 


THE OPPORTUNITY

Great creative starts with a sharp idea, and the earlier it arrives, the better the work gets. As our Creative Strategist & Producer, you bring ideas in at the start of a campaign and you can also make them. Up to half the role is writing complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, and sometimes organic and social, then briefing them into our creatives and designers. The other half is making work yourself, in whatever format you’re strongest at. You also help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing write stronger briefs of their own.

 

This role is for a proactive self-starter. Nobody will hand you the idea: you go and find it, pitch it and get it made.

 

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You work daily with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, who bring deep knowledge of the product and the media channels, and with the creatives who bring your briefs to life.

 

 - Spot opportunities in culture every day. Watch pop culture, trends, competitors, comments and performance data, and turn what you find into ideas we ship the same week. Stay close to financial markets and to Kraken’s audience.

 - Write complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, built with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, and brief them into the performance creatives and designers.

 - Help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing managers sharpen their own briefs, bringing the concept, the hook and the cultural angle to the start of the process.

 - Pitch original concepts for paid and social before anyone asks, so ideas reach the team already sharp.

 - Make your own content for paid and organic. The format is open: you could be a meme machine, an AI video specialist, someone who performs to camera, or something we haven’t thought of. What matters is that it feels native to the feed and ships fast.

 - Use performance data and social listening as creative input, and get more distinct angles into tests each month.Performance Marketing owns test design and readouts; you own the creative response.

 - React inside the news cycle. You spot the moment, and you brief it or make it yourself.

 - Partner with Product Marketing and compliance to get work approved without losing the idea.

 - Keep your briefs and files clean enough for other people to build on.

 
 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5+ years in creative strategy, social, content or performance creative at a high-volume in-house team, brand or agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

 - A portfolio submitted with your application. Include two or three concept-led briefs or concept decks, with what shipped and how it performed where you’re able to share it, plus work you made yourself in the formats that are your strength. Include one idea you spotted in culture or data and took to market, with a short note on what the results told you and what you changed.

 - A proactive, self-starting way of working. You find the idea, pitch it and drive it to be shipped without waiting to be asked, and you’re comfortable owning your workflow with light direction.

 - Pop-culture fluency and a chronically online persona, with comedic instinct and a sense for what’s about to feel dated.

 - A performance marketer’s grip on what a good brief needs: a clear objective, audience, hook, platform, format and set of constraints, and the ability to coach others toward it.

 - A creative superpower you can execute on alone, with shipped work to show for it.

 - Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and X. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

 - Fluency in the metrics creative moves, and the habit of using performance data and social listening as inputs to ideas.

 - A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.

 - Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with concepts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements.

 - Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

Job Profile: HR Business Partner

Position overview

Job title: HR Business Partner (HRBP)

Department: People

Business unit supported: Revenue

Reports to: CHRO

Direct reports: None

Key stakeholders: Revenue leadership and managers; People Partners team; Administration; Finance; Legal; Talent Acquisition; external EOR, relocation and immigration providers.

Company context
This role combines business partnering for the Revenue unit with hands-on ownership of HR operations: documentation, employment through EOR, and visa and relocation support. It suits someone who can advise leaders strategically and also get the paperwork right.

Key responsibilities

Business partnering

• Act as the main HR point of contact for managers, and translate business goals into people priorities.

• Advise on team structure, workforce planning and headcount in line with the business targets.

• Support performance management, goal setting and feedback cycles, and coach managers on people decisions.

• Partner with Finance and department leadership on the people side of compensation and bonus plans.

• Collect and analyse people data (turnover, engagement, performance) and turn it into recommendations.

Employee relations and communication

• Handle incident management: address negative situations, escalate relevant information, and follow cases through to resolution.

• Mediate conflicts and help build constructive communication between employees and teams.

• Take part in offboarding: run exit interviews and share turnover insights with stakeholders.

• Manage internal transfers and promotions, including moves into management roles.

HR processes and change

• Design, implement and maintain HR processes, adapting them as the company becomes more structured.

• Support change management during reorganisations and process changes.

• Lead HR projects and ad-hoc requests, and run research and consultations when needed.

HR operations and documentation

• Maintain employee documentation and records: contracts, amendments, policies and HRIS data.

• Manage employment of team members hired through Employer of Record (EOR) providers, covering onboarding, contract changes, offboarding and vendor coordination.

• Coordinate visa, work permit and relocation support: prepare documents, work with immigration providers, and track deadlines and renewals.

• Ensure HR practices comply with local labour laws in all countries where we employ people, working with Legal.

• Prepare HR letters and certificates, such as employment confirmations and reference letters.

Requirements

• 3+ years of hands-on HR experience, including at least 1 year as an HRBP or People Partner.

• Experience supporting sales or other commercial teams is a strong plus.

• Practical experience with EOR providers, visa or work permit processes, and HR documentation.

• Experience in a fast-growing international company.

• English С1; Russian is a plus.

• Confident user of an HRIS (e.g. HiBob) and Google Workspace/MS Office.

Hard skills

• Full HR lifecycle knowledge and the ability to apply it in practice.

• Understanding of commercial team dynamics: sales metrics, incentive plans, quota-driven performance.

• Working knowledge of labour law and employment compliance across several jurisdictions.

• EOR models, immigration and relocation processes.

• Project management and change management.

• Facilitation, moderation and group work.

• Basic HR analytics: collecting, analysing and presenting people data.

• Coaching and mentoring managers.

• Basic understanding of the company's product and tech stack.

Soft skills

• High emotional intelligence and strong communication skills.

• Business acumen and credibility with senior commercial leaders.

• Attention to detail and accuracy with documents and deadlines.

• Resilience and composure in a high-pace environment.

• Ability to handle strategic and operational work at the same time.

• Ownership and independence; drives tasks to completion.

• Adaptability to ongoing internal and external change.

• Strong planning and time management.

• Discretion with confidential information.

Trade Solutions - Operations Engineer (Mid-Level)

Position Summary

We are looking for a Trade Solutions - Operations Engineer with approximately 3–4 years’ relevant experience in trading technology, FX/CFD brokerage operations, electronic trading, platform support, market data, connectivity or a related financial services environment.

The role will support the day-to-day operation, investigation and continuous improvement of our trading solutions across trading platforms, trade lifecycle processes, liquidity connectivity, market data and operational controls.

You will work independently on operational and technical tasks, investigate incidents and discrepancies, support testing and controlled system changes, and collaborate with teams across the business to maintain reliable and well-governed trading operations.

A strong understanding of FX/CFD brokerage operations, combined with analytical ability, attention to detail and sound operational judgement, will be important for success in the role.

Key Responsibilities

• Support and monitor trading platforms, trade lifecycle processes, liquidity connectivity, market data and related Trade Solutions services.

• Investigate execution, pricing, connectivity, reconciliation and platform issues, identifying root causes and coordinating resolution or escalation.

• Work with trading platforms and infrastructure including MT4/MT5, bridges, liquidity providers, routing configurations, FIX/API connectivity and market data feeds.

• Monitor operational data, identify anomalies and investigate discrepancies or potential trading risks.

• Support UAT, regression testing, releases, incident validation and post-change verification for system and configuration changes.

• Maintain clear documentation covering investigations, incidents, testing, changes and operational procedures.

• Support controlled changes to trading systems, connectivity and routing, ensuring appropriate testing, approvals and rollback arrangements are in place.

• Collaborate with Trade Solutions, Dealing, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Technology and external providers to resolve issues and improve service reliability.

• Identify opportunities to improve monitoring, reporting, processes, documentation and operational controls.

• Escalate material incidents, unexplained discrepancies and potential operational or trading risks appropriately.

• Share knowledge and contribute to troubleshooting guides and operational best practice.

Required Experience and Skills

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Finance, Economics, Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Analytics or a related discipline.

• 3–4 years’ relevant experience within trade solutions, FX/CFD brokerage operations, electronic trading, platform support, financial technology, connectivity or market data.

• Practical understanding of trading platforms, brokerage workflows and trade lifecycle processes.

• Strong analytical, numerical and problem-solving skills.

• Experience investigating operational or technical incidents, analysing discrepancies and coordinating resolutions.

• Familiarity with incident management, UAT, change management and operational controls.

• Good working knowledge of Excel and experience analysing operational data.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to different stakeholders.

• Ability to work independently, prioritise competing requirements and take ownership of issues through to resolution.

• Strong judgement, accountability, confidentiality and risk awareness.

Preferred Technical Knowledge

Experience in some of the following would be advantageous:

• MT4 and/or MT5 administration, configuration, monitoring or support.

• PrimeXM XCore, oneZero Hub and/or Centroid CS360.

• FIX protocol, APIs, trading bridges, liquidity provider connectivity, order routing and market data feeds.

• FX/CFD trading concepts including spreads, markups, swaps, margin, leverage, slippage and execution quality.

• SQL, Python or scripting for data analysis, troubleshooting, automation or reporting.

• Working with liquidity providers, bridge providers, trading technology vendors or third-party integrations.

• Monitoring tools, incident management systems, ticketing platforms or operational dashboards.

• UAT, release management, change governance and operational risk controls.

Governance and Controls

You will be expected to operate within established risk, information security, access management and change-control frameworks.

This includes maintaining accurate records, protecting confidential trading and client information, following appropriate approval and testing procedures for production changes, and escalating critical incidents or control issues promptly.

Sound judgement is essential, particularly when determining whether an issue can be resolved independently or requires specialist or management escalation.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

• Taking ownership of operational and technical issues through to resolution.

• Investigating platform, execution, connectivity, pricing and data issues effectively.

• Producing accurate, evidence-based analysis and documentation.

• Following established controls without compromising operational safety.

• Identifying recurring issues and recommending practical improvements.

• Building effective relationships across technical, operational and business teams.

• Contributing to more efficient processes, stronger monitoring and improved operational resilience.

Reporting Line

The Trade Solutions - Operations Engineer reports to the assigned Trade Solutions Manager or Head of Trade Solutions and works closely with Dealing, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Technology and relevant external technology and liquidity providers.

Development Opportunities

This is a mid-level role for someone who can contribute effectively from the outset while continuing to develop deeper expertise across Trade Solutions.

Depending on experience, performance and business requirements, there may be opportunities to specialise further in areas such as Trade Solutions Operations, Electronic Trading Connectivity, Trading Platforms, Governance and Audit, or Market Data, with progression towards senior or specialist positions.

Job Description
Operating within the First Line of Defence, the Fraud Software Engineer serves as the core technical builder for the Anti-Fraud & Financial Crime squad. Working directly alongside the Squad Lead and Data Scientists , this role bridges analytical fraud detection and full-stack software execution.
You will own the technical evolution of the back-office platforms on which anti-fraud and AML services run, develop and deploy internal front-end screens when new operational workflows are needed, and build robust Python backend services and API integrations. This is a high-ownership, hands-on engineering and data role for a pragmatic problem-solver who unblocks operational bottlenecks, thrives during live incident response, and focuses on shipping working solutions.
Key Responsibilities :
• Back-Office Service Evolution: Modify, extend, and maintain the internal back-office platforms and case-management systems supporting daily anti-fraud and AML operations.
• Python Backend & Rules Execution: Design, write, and deploy clean, production-grade Python services to execute real-time transaction monitoring rules, automated blocking workflows, and dynamic risk-scoring logic.
• System Reliability & Optimization: Monitor technical health across fraud services and data pipelines, proactively resolving latency issues, data flow failures, and operational bottlenecks.
• Internal Screen Development: Build, iterate, and deploy lightweight, intuitive front-end screens and web interfaces (e.g. , alert triage views, manual review dashboards, and rule-configuration panels) whenever operational teams require new UI capabilities.
• User Acceptance Testing (UAT) & Feedback Loops: Partner directly with fraud investigators, Customer Care, and Compliance to translate operational pain points into rapid UI/UX improvements and support UAT cycles.
• Service & Vendor Integrations: Build and maintain API integrations connecting core banking/payment rails, internal microservices, third-party fraud prevention vendors, and threat intelligence feeds (such as OpenCTI).
• Database & Search Engineering: Design, optimize, and maintain queries and schemas across relational and non-relational databases as well as search/telemetry engines (SQL, ES|QL).
• Forensic Querying & Pattern Discovery: Execute deep-dive data extraction and forensic analysis using Python, SQL, and ES|QL to investigate complex fraud typologies, web traffic anomalies, and high-value incidents.
• Productionizing Detection Models: Collaborate closely with the Fraud Officers and Data scientists to integrate machine learning models, feature pipelines, and threshold adjustments into live production environments.
• Operational Reporting Support: Automate data feeds and technical metrics powering weekly/monthly KPI and KRI dashboards.
• Rapid Emergency Execution: Act as a frontline technical responder during critical fraud incidents (eg, Account Takeover or APP fraud spikes), implementing urgent backend rule updates, hotfixes, or blocking criteria under tight timelines.
• Audit-Ready Documentation: Maintain clear technical documentation covering architecture changes, API integrations, system logic, and post-incident root-cause analyzes to meet internal governance and regulatory audit standards.

Qualifications
Experience & Background :
• 5+ of hands-on experience in software engineering, backend/full-stack Python development, or technical data engineering—ideally within banking, fintech, payments, or financial crime/fraud operations.
• Proven track record modifying existing legacy or internal back-office systems while shipping new end-to-end features in an agile squad environment.
Core Technical Skills :
• Strong Python Engineering (Mandatory): Advanced proficiency in Python for backend service development, API consumption/creation, automation scripting, and large-scale data manipulation.
• Data & Querying Mastery (Mandatory): Strong command of SQL and experience with log/telemetry querying (such as Elastic Stack / ES|QL), alongside solid working knowledge of relational and non-relational databases.
• Backend & Web Frameworks: Practical experience building and deploying web services and APIs using Python frameworks
• Front-End Capabilities: Ability to develop and deploy functional front-end screens using modern web technologies (HTML/CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, React,or Python-based web frameworks) when operational interfaces are required.
• DevOps & Engineering Hygiene: Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), automated testing, and debugging production web traffic and network payloads.
• Analytics & Visualization: Experience extracting actionable insights from complex datasets and familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
• Solution-Oriented Builder: A pragmatic, can-do engineering mindset—focused on finding compliant, workable paths forward.
• High Ownership & Execution Bias: Self-starter who takes end-to-end accountability from technical scoping and coding through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
• Analytical Rigor: Natural curiosity for dissecting data anomalies, understanding adversarial fraud mechanics, and tracing root causes across complex systems.
• Composure & Clear Communication: Able to stay calm and decisive during live fraud incidents while translating technical trade-offs clearly for non-technical stakeholders across Operations, Risk, and Compliance.

Additional Information

Founded in 2014, Tickmill has grown into a global financial services group of 300+ people, with regulated entities across major jurisdictions and a client base built on trust in active trading, spanning CFDs, Futures and Options.

That foundation: capital, licensing, infrastructure and an established international client base ,is what makes the next stage possible: building genuinely new product lines in Stocks, ETFs, Investing, Wealth and Prediction Markets, aimed at a much larger consumer audience than our existing trading business alone.

The Head of Product, Prediction Markets will have the opportunity to:

• Own and drive the launch and growth of Tickmill's Prediction Markets offering.

• Be accountable for the unit’s P&L with the respective business owner

• Define product strategy, roadmap, and business objectives for event-based trading products.

• Partner with Engineering, UX/UI designers, QA, Compliance, Operations, Sales, Marketing, and Affiliates teams to deliver products from concept to market.

• Define and prioritize features based on customer needs, regulatory requirements, technical feasibility, liquidity considerations, and business objectives.

• Work with data providers, liquidity providers, market makers, exchanges, and technology vendors where required.

• Partner with Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Affiliate teams to develop acquisition, activation, retention, and engagement strategies for Prediction Markets.

• Establish KPIs and continuously optimize liquidity, user engagement, retention, trading activity, and commercial performance.

• Champion a simple, transparent, and mobile-first trading experience.

• 7+ years of Product Management experience.

• 3+ years building, launching, or managing Prediction Markets, Event Contracts, or similar event-driven trading products.

• Deep understanding of prediction market mechanics, market creation, liquidity dynamics, event lifecycle management, settlement processes, probability-based pricing, and market integrity controls.

• Proven track record of launching and scaling prediction market or event-based trading products.

• Proved experience working for a large and established Broker or Gaming company

• Proven experience creating and improving onboarding journeys and product experiences, with strong expertise in UX, customer behavior, conversion optimization, and data-driven decision-making.

• Experience designing, optimizing, or supporting affiliate, referral, introducing broker (IB), partner, and influencer acquisition journeys.

• Strong understanding of user acquisition, engagement, activation, retention, and liquidity growth strategies.

• Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives.

• Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to product decision-making.

• Strong technical fluency and ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams.

• Collaboration with SportBenefit.

• Product and stakeholder management interview.

• Final interview with top management.

Make your next career step and apply NOW!

Refactoring, technical debt and incident architecture
• Own the portfolio of product and system refactoring and migration initiatives: scope, phasing, expected benefits (stability, performance, maintainability, scalability, delivery efficiency), technical risks, legacy constraints and dependencies, with progress and phase outcomes reported against ETA.
• Lead root-cause analysis for major technical and architecture issues and high-risk production incidents, and define both the short-term fix and the long-term architecture solution, with owner, ETA and residual risk.
• Drive cross-team alignment on technical direction so that Product, Engineering, Data and Platform teams build towards the same target architecture.
Delivery, capacity and cost discipline
• Run AO's weekly management cadence with the CTO: pre-read updates covering incidents, priority projects, refactoring progress, standards and documentation, team capacity and cost; every item with owner, ETA, risk and next action.
• Maintain effort and time estimates for programmes and refactoring work, track AO effort by person, role and project, and present internal cost versus market benchmark to support budgeting and resourcing decisions.
• Provide structured, trackable fields on architecture and refactoring work to the Tech PMO dashboard and Data Team, so architecture delivery is measurable alongside the rest of Tech.
People leadership
• Lead and grow the Architecture Office: define roles and responsibilities, and establish review, mentoring and knowledge-sharing rhythms.
• Grow architecture capability across engineering teams through an architecture guild, design-review coaching and reusable patterns and reference implementations.
• Potentially host and lead an AI / emerging-technology architecture function, including responsible-AI and AI-governance considerations with Cyber Security and Compliance.
Stakeholder and vendor management
• Advise the CTO and CEO on technology direction, build-versus-buy decisions and major technical risks.
• Partner with the Heads of Product Engineering, Platform Engineering, Corporate IT, Data and Cyber Security as a peer in the Tech management team.

Requirements

• Proven design of distributed, highly available, low-latency systems, ideally trading or financial platforms; deep hands-on AWS expertise (multi-account landing zone, networking and IAM, containers / Kubernetes, event-driven and microservice architectures, resilience and DR).
• Led large-scale refactoring, re-platforming or migration programmes from legacy systems with measurable outcomes in stability, performance or delivery speed.
• Established architecture governance from scratch or matured it significantly: standards, Architecture Decision Records, review boards, technical acceptance criteria and documentation discipline.

• Cost and estimation discipline: effort and timeline estimation for programmes, cloud cost optimisation, and benchmarking internal cost against market.

At Tradeify, we are building a high-performance trading ecosystem that empowers traders around the world with capital, technology, education, and community. We operate across futures and crypto markets and partner with platforms like NinjaTrader and Tradovate to deliver a best-in-class trading experience.



As we continue scaling rapidly, trader support sits at the center of everything we do. We are looking for a talented Trader Support Specialist who thrives in fast-paced environments and understands how traders think.




THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Trader Support Specialist to be the first point of contact for our traders, resolving their questions quickly and accurately through Intercom. This role is ideal for someone with real experience in crypto, futures, FX or perps who has worked directly with traders and enjoys turning a stressful moment into a solved problem.



You will work closely with Support, Product, Risk and Operations teams to deliver a trader experience that is clear, fast and trusted, and that directly impacts traders globally.



This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys moving quickly, staying composed when markets move, and making a difference one conversation at a time.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Respond to trader inquiries in Intercom through chat and email, keeping response times and quality high.

 - Help traders with account access, evaluations and funded account questions, rules and requirements, payouts, platform and data feed issues, and trading conditions.

 - Explain trading rules and account parameters clearly, in language traders understand.

 - Troubleshoot platform, connectivity and account issues, and escalate complex cases to the right internal team with full context.

 - Keep Intercom conversations tagged, documented and up to date, and use macros and saved replies consistently.

 - Flag recurring issues, product gaps and trader sentiment to the Support, Product and Risk teams.

 - Help build and improve the help center, macros and internal knowledge base.

 - Support traders during high-volume periods such as market events, launches and promotions.




REQUIREMENTS

 - Hands-on experience in crypto, futures, FX or perps, as a trader or in a role that supported traders.

 - Proven experience supporting or working directly with traders, and comfort with how they communicate under pressure.

 - Working knowledge of Intercom, including inbox management, macros, tags and reporting.

 - A solid grasp of core trading concepts such as order types, margin, leverage, drawdown, P&L and risk management.

 - Clear, concise and empathetic written communication, with strong attention to detail.

 - Sound judgment on when to resolve a case and when to escalate it.

 - Ability to stay composed and responsive in fast-moving, high-volume situations.

 - Comfort working across time zones and flexible hours, as markets run around the clock.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience at a prop firm or funded trader program.

 - Familiarity with trading platforms such as NinjaTrader, Tradovate, TradingView, MetaTrader or major crypto exchanges.

 - Experience with Slack, Notion or help center tools alongside Intercom.

 - Additional languages.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Join a professional-grade trading firm at a pivotal stage of growth

 - Work with and learn from experienced traders across multiple asset classes

 - High-performance culture that rewards ownership, curiosity, and results

 - Access to premium market data tools, exchange infrastructure, and industry resources

 - Competitive base salary, performance bonuses, and comprehensive benefits




A NOTE ON OUR HIRING PROCESS

At Tradeify, we use AI-assisted tools as part of our recruiting process, which may include resume screening, application review, and candidate communication. We want all applicants to be aware of this upfront so you can make an informed decision about applying. Final hiring decisions are always made by a member of our team.

Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About the Role

Crypto financial markets generate enormous arbitrage opportunities, signals, and price dislocations every day — but most users lack the expertise to act on them. The AI Strategy Engineer we're looking for is someone who can transform these opportunities into executable AI-powered applications: one-click arbitrage, automated yield optimization, AI trading signals — giving ordinary users access to strategy capabilities that were previously reserved for institutional players.

You will lead strategy research, design, and deployment — developing deep expertise in funding rate arbitrage, basis trading, stablecoin yield strategies, cross-exchange arbitrage, and more. You will combine quantitative strategy logic with AI Agent execution frameworks to build automated systems that directly drive user retention and asset growth. This isn't a pure quant role, nor a pure engineering role — you need to understand markets, understand strategies, and know how to turn them into products users can actually use.

Key Responsibilities

•

Quantitative Strategy Research & Design: Research executable arbitrage opportunities in crypto markets including funding rate arbitrage, basis trading (perpetuals vs. delivery), stablecoin yield strategies (stablecoin lending loops, Launchpool hedging), and cross-exchange arbitrage. Complete strategy logic design, historical backtesting, and risk-adjusted return validation.

•

AI Strategy Application Development: Package quantitative strategies into user-facing AI applications. Design execution workflows, trigger conditions, position management, and risk controls for scenarios such as one-click arbitrage, automated yield optimization, and promotional opportunity capturing. Integrate AI Agent capabilities to enable automated strategy analysis, decision-making, and execution.

•

Market Signal & Intelligence System: Build a multi-source market intelligence capability integrating exchange market data, on-chain data, and community sentiment signals. Use AI models to identify hot opportunities, entry timing, and take-profit/stop-loss strategies, providing users with disciplined, AI-assisted trading signals.

•

Strategy Risk Control & Position Management: Design risk frameworks for each strategy class, including maximum drawdown controls, dynamic position calibration, and circuit breakers for extreme market conditions. Regularly analyze live strategy performance, identify degradation factors, and drive iterative optimization.

•

Strategy Productization for User Scenarios: Develop a deep understanding of different user personas (conservative yield-seekers vs. active traders) and translate strategy capabilities into perceivable product value — defining the core interaction logic, return visualization, and risk communication for strategy applications.

•

Cross-System Strategy Integration: Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate strategies with exchange APIs (including third-party exchanges), and drive the engineering delivery of automated strategy execution with unified cross-exchange asset management.

Requirements

•

Quantitative Strategy Experience: 3+ years of quantitative strategy research or trading experience, with at least one strategy class delivered end-to-end in production (funding rate arbitrage, basis trading, statistical arbitrage, market-neutral, etc.); proficient with backtesting frameworks and able to independently conduct strategy validation and attribution analysis.

•

Deep Crypto Market Knowledge: Strong command of crypto derivatives market mechanics including perpetual contract funding rates, delivery futures basis dynamics, stablecoin protocol yield structures (USDE / USD1 / BYUSD etc.), and DeFi protocol return mechanisms. Live trading strategy experience is strongly preferred.

•

Programming & Data Analysis: Proficient in Python for strategy development and data analysis (Pandas / NumPy / backtesting frameworks); experience with exchange API integration; able to work with market tick data, funding rate history, and other quantitative datasets.

•

AI / Agent Integration: Hands-on experience building LLM applications or AI Agents; able to encapsulate strategy logic as agent-callable tools and construct automated strategy pipelines from signal analysis through decision-making to execution.

•

Business Acumen & Product Thinking: Able to identify actionable strategy opportunities from a user-value perspective and translate complex quantitative strategies into understandable, actionable product experiences; capable of independently driving strategy concepts from 0 to 1.

Nice to Have

•

Live trading experience with cross-exchange arbitrage (funding rate, cross-exchange spread, basis arbitrage) or on-chain DeFi strategies.

•

Familiarity with on-chain analytics tools (Dune / Nansen / Glassnode) for mining strategy signals from on-chain indicators.

•

Experience developing and operating automated trading systems (quant trading bots, grid strategies, DCA systems, etc.).

•

Understanding of AI-driven signal generation, with practical experience combining market sentiment and quantitative models.

Key Responsibilities

Exchange Platform Performance

•

Optimize order entry, risk, matching and market data processing paths.

•

Identify bottlenecks across order validation, risk checks, matching, execution reporting and market data publication.

•

Improve latency, throughput, jitter and scalability.

•

Translate exchange and market-structure requirements into high-performance designs.

•

Evaluate trade-offs between performance, resilience and maintainability.

Low-Latency Architecture and Software

•

Design architectures and data flows for latency-critical exchange components.

•

Optimize concurrency, thread scheduling, memory access and data structures.

•

Apply cache-efficient design, memory alignment, allocation avoidance and zero-copy processing.

•

Design lock-free or wait-free algorithms and high-performance queues.

•

Reduce unnecessary processing, copying, serialization and context switching.

Protocol, Network and System Optimization

•

Design and optimize binary protocols and communication between gateways, risk engines, matching engines and market data components.

•

Improve serialization, IPC, messaging, buffering, batching and backpressure handling.

•

Work with FIX, FIXP, SBE and proprietary exchange protocols.

•

Evaluate technologies such as Aeron, TIBCO FTL, DPDK and Solarflare OpenOnload.

•

Optimize NIC queues, interrupts, packet processing and memory buffers.

•

Apply CPU isolation, thread pinning, IRQ affinity and NUMA-aware resource allocation.

•

Analyze cache behavior, context switches, page faults, microbursts, queueing and tail-latency variation.

•

Collaborate with Infrastructure Engineering on Linux, firmware, BIOS, NIC and server configuration.

Performance Measurement

•

Establish representative benchmarks for exchange workloads.

•

Measure component and end-to-end latency, including p50, p99, p99.9 and p99.99.

•

Build profiling, tracing and automated performance-regression capabilities.

•

Investigate latency spikes, jitter and throughput limitations.

•

Reproduce production performance issues and translate findings into engineering improvements.

•

Use reliable performance evidence to guide architecture and protocol decisions.

Required Qualifications

•

10+ years of experience as a software engineer.

•

5+ years working with trading technology, exchange infrastructure, HFT, market making or financial-market infrastructure.

•

Experience building or optimizing production trading systems with latency below 100 microseconds.

•

Experience with order entry gateways, market data distribution, risk engines or matching engines.

•

Experience profiling latency-critical systems and analyzing latency distributions.

•

Ability to investigate performance across application, protocol, network, operating-system and hardware layers.

•

Strong hands-on technical expertise in:

•

C++ and Java

•

Linux systems

•

Networking

•

Concurrency

•

Low-latency architecture

•

Memory optimization

•

Lock-free systems

•

Binary protocols

•

Tail-latency optimization

Preferred Qualifications

•

Experience with FIX, FIXP, SBE or proprietary exchange protocols.

•

Experience with Aeron, TIBCO FTL or similar messaging technologies.

•

Experience with DPDK, Solarflare OpenOnload or equivalent user-space networking.

•

Knowledge of SPSC/MPSC queues, NUMA, huge pages, CPU pinning and cache-line optimization.

•

Familiarity with Linux perf, eBPF, flame graphs and hardware performance counters.

•

Understanding of exchange market structure, order lifecycle, pre-trade risk, matching engines and market data distribution.

This role owns the end-to-end global financial crime transaction monitoring and investigation lifecycle, functioning as an integrated process chain spanning strategy, policy and procedure design, transaction monitoring rules design and management, transaction monitoring technology, Level 1 quality and SLA governance, Level 2 complex investigations, risk mitigation decisions, and SAR/STR filings across sanctions, AML/CFT, fraud, and complex fiat/crypto typologies.
You will set the global strategy, policies, and implementation procedures; continuously adapt the program to evolving financial crime risks; and assess Crypto.com’s overall transactional financial crime risk posture. Combining deep financial crime expertise with rigorous operational and process discipline, you will directly lead the global rules design, transaction monitoring, investigations, and SARs teams across North America, EMEA, and APAC, while exercising functional oversight over Level 1 alert operations by setting their procedures, monitoring their SLAs, and governing their output quality. You will own our transaction monitoring platforms, maintain real-time operational dashboards, and remain directly involved in complex casework, data analysis, and written work product. Additionally, the role includes interfacing with regulators during examinations and supporting law enforcement and financial intelligence unit engagements. Reporting to the SVP, Compliance in the US, you will partner closely with regional compliance teams, Operations, Data, and Product leadership to keep Crypto.com’s defenses ahead of emerging threats.

Global FIU Strategy & Operating Model

• Define and own the multi-year global FIU strategy, target operating model, and investigative standards, aligned to the firm’s licensing footprint, product roadmap, and regulatory risk appetite.

• Manage the full transactional financial crime process chain, from rule design and alert generation through triage, escalation, investigation, risk mitigation, and SAR/STR reporting, ensuring global consistency with appropriate local tailoring.

• Continuously assess Crypto.com’s overall financial crime posture from a transactional risk perspective, proactively adapting rules, workflows, and controls to evolving money laundering, sanctions evasion, fraud, and terrorist financing typologies.

NEXT Ventures Ltd. is a global fintech group that owns and operates FundedNext, a leading proprietary trading platform, and FNmarkets, a CFD brokerage. Operating across five countries, the group brings together a diverse team of professionals to deliver technology-driven trading solutions and serve a global community of traders from over 170 countries.

Your Role in Our Mission
As an Executive – FNmarkets, you are responsible for running the reconciliation cycle across CRM, core transaction platform, and Payment Service Provider (PSP) platforms for NEXT Bangladesh—enabling a twice-daily reconciliation standard that catches discrepancies on the same day. You also own ApprovalMax bill processing, withdrawable profit calculations, periodic management and regulatory financial reporting, and performance dashboard maintenance. Working alongside the Senior Executive and Internal Audit Executive, you support PSP and Xero processing, revenue and partner entries, and Back Office withdrawal reviews to uphold audit readiness, regulatory compliance, and timely, accurate reporting.

How You’ll Make an Impact (Key Responsibilities)
1. Reconciliation Cycle (CRM, Core Platform & PSP)
•
Daily Execution: Own and execute the daily reconciliation cycle across CRM, core transaction platform, and PSP platforms for NEXT Bangladesh.
•
Discrepancy Resolution: Identify, document, and escalate same-day discrepancies, including CRM vs. core platform balance mismatches and PSP settlement variances.
•
Midday Cut-Off: Complete the cycle by the defined midday cut-off, creating a clean mid-day checkpoint ahead of the closing cycle.
•
Audit Readiness: Maintain audit-ready reconciliation logs in line with regulatory and internal control requirements.
2. PSP Transaction Processing & Xero Upload
•
Daily Categorization: Identify and categorize PSP deposits, withdrawals, and fees daily.
•
Xero Uploads: Upload PSP transactions into Xero on a daily basis.
•
Monthly Reconciliation: Perform monthly PSP reconciliation and balance checks under the Senior Executive’s review.
3. Revenue & Partner Entry Support
•
Daily Entries: Assist in daily revenue recognition, partner profitability, and negative balance uploads to Xero.
•
Accuracy & Timeliness: Support the Senior Executive in maintaining the accuracy and timeliness of daily entries.
4. ApprovalMax Bills Processing & Withdrawable Profit Calculation
•
Payables Management: Process and manage bills for NEXT Bangladesh through the ApprovalMax workflow.
•
Approval Routing: Ensure all payables are submitted, routed, and approved in line with internal approval hierarchies and entity-level controls.
•
Close Documentation: Maintain accurate records of processed bills for audit and month-end close.
•
Withdrawable Profit: Calculate withdrawable profit from client balances in line with internal policies and platform rules, submitting within defined timelines to support Operations and PT operations.
5. Financial Reporting & Performance Dashboard
•
Management & Regulatory Reporting: Prepare and submit periodic management reporting packs and regulatory financial reports for NEXT Bangladesh within defined deadlines.
•
Dashboard Maintenance: Maintain and update the performance dashboard with key financial metrics, including revenue, partner profitability, reconciliation status, and PSP settlement balances.
•
Quality Assurance: Ensure all reports and dashboard data are accurate, complete, and ready for management review.
6. Operations Review, Process Documentation & Collaboration
•
Withdrawal Reviews: Support Ops withdrawal transaction reviews during the cycle, acting as first-line checker for routine items and escalating irregularities.
•
Process Documentation: Support the build-out of process documentation for NEXT Bangladesh, identifying workflow gaps and flagging them for improvement.
•
Stakeholder Communication: Maintain professional and timely communication with internal and external stakeholders.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) & Tracking Cadence
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
•
Reconciliation Cycle: 100% of reconciliation cycles completed by the defined midday cut-off; discrepancy detection window reduced to under 12 hours; zero reconciliation compliance gaps with audit-ready logs.
•
PSP, Revenue & Partner Processing: 100% of PSP transactions identified and uploaded into Xero within weekly deadlines; 100% of supported daily revenue, partner, and negative balance entries uploaded within defined timelines; minimal or zero revisions required in submitted data.
•
ApprovalMax & Withdrawable Profit: Zero overdue or mis-routed bills in ApprovalMax; withdrawable profit calculations delivered accurately and on time with zero post-submission corrections.
•
Financial Reporting & Dashboard: Zero late or revised management reports; all regulatory submissions filed within defined deadlines; performance dashboard updated on schedule with accurate, current data.
•
Ops Review & Collaboration: 100% of Back Office withdrawal transactions in the cycle reviewed within the same session; 95% or higher stakeholder responses within 24 hours; at least one process improvement or documentation gap identified per quarter.
Tracking and Monitoring Methods
•
Daily: Reconciliation cycle (CRM, core platform, PSP), same-day discrepancy escalation, Ops withdrawal review, and revenue/partner/negative balance entry support.
•
Weekly: PSP transaction identification and Xero upload, ApprovalMax bill processing, and dashboard updates.
•
Monthly: PSP reconciliation and balance checks, management and regulatory reporting, withdrawable profit calculations, and month-end bill records.
•
Quarterly: Process documentation review and process improvement tracking.

The Account team owns how every OKX user first gets in and keeps getting in safely. That covers registration, login and authentication, session and device management, account recovery, account security, sub-accounts and institutional accounts, and the full account lifecycle. We build the identity and access foundation that every other product depends on. That foundation has to scale to millions of users across regions and be resilient against constant attack, while still feeling easy to use. Our goal is a platform where strong security and a smooth user experience support each other rather than compete. For accounts, "mostly secure" isn't secure. Every control we build has to be consistent in how it's enforced, complete in what it covers, and explainable when it acts.

What You'll Be Doing

•

Formulate, select and develop technical designs across the account domain. That includes registration and onboarding, login and multi-factor authentication, passwordless login, third-party and single sign-on, session and device management, account recovery, sub-account and institutional account structures, and account lifecycle controls such as freezing, closure and data retention.

•

Build AI/ML-powered features such as account-takeover detection, suspicious-login detection, automated attack and bot defense, risk-based authentication, smarter recovery flows, and support-assist tools for account issues.

•

Organize and coordinate resources, lead research and development, troubleshoot problems, and ensure quality and on-time delivery. This includes integrating AI models into login, risk and recovery workflows.

•

Facilitate cross-team communication and promote efficient teamwork through code quality control and collaboration. This includes partnering with Security, Risk, Data Science, Compliance and Customer Support to bring models into production on reliable, auditable infrastructure.

•

Define where AI-driven judgment is appropriate and where fixed rules are mandatory. For example, a risk score can trigger an extra verification step, but the final access decision and its record have to stay rule-based. Design that boundary cleanly so models help without weakening security guarantees.

•

Take on team tasks and develop technical talent, with a focus on building AI engineering best practices across the team. That means AI-assisted development workflows, reusable prompt patterns, quality evaluation, and human review of AI-generated work in security-critical areas.

What We Look For In You

•

A security-first systems mindset. You naturally design for reliability, safe retries, consistent state, abuse prevention and complete audit trails. You know that in account security, missing an attack means a hijacked account and lost funds, while blocking a real user means lost trust, and you design with both in mind. Prior experience with identity, authentication, access management, anti-fraud or account security is a strong plus. Hands-on experience handling a real account-takeover incident or large-scale attack is an even stronger plus.

•

Solid knowledge of modern authentication and authorization standards, and their common pitfalls.

•

Daily, fluent use of modern AI coding tools. You can describe the specific workflows you run, the failure modes you've hit, and the guardrails you've built around AI-generated code, especially in security-sensitive code. AI fluency is required, not nice-to-have.

Production experience integrating AI/ML models into backend services. That includes model serving, real-time signal and data pipelines, low-latency inference on critical user paths, safe fallback when models fail, and processes for monitoring and rolling back models.

Hands-on experience with at least one LLM application pattern: knowledge retrieval for support and internal lookup, multi-step AI assistants for support or risk analysts, or LLM-based classification or extraction shipped to production.

Crypto.com is a global cryptocurrency platform serving traders and investors in markets around the world. The CDC product line is our international crypto trading app — spanning spot, perpetual contracts, and card rips — and we are building the next generation of trading products for a global audience.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Growth to sit at the intersection of user acquisition, creative strategy, martech, and measurement. This is not a single-lane role. You’ll own the day-to-day performance of our UA program across paid channels and every market we operate in, but you’ll also lead three critical sub-functions — creative, martech, and measurement — that today sit with senior leadership and need a dedicated operator to take them to the next level.

You’ll work directly with our agency partners, product teams, data science, and platform reps (Meta, Google, Apple) across regions. You’ll inherit a scaled UA program with multiple products launching simultaneously, a global market footprint, and a martech stack that’s being built in real time. If you’re the kind of person who can context-switch between a Meta CAPI payload spec and a creative brief in the same afternoon, this role was made for you.

Responsibilities 
User Acquisition Operations

• Own the weekly operating rhythm for CDC paid UA — spend plans, pacing, optimization decisions, and performance reporting across all channels (Meta, Google, Apple Search, programmatic DSPs, affiliates, regional platforms, and emerging networks), across every market we operate in

• Manage the relationship with our performance agency on a daily basis — standups, creative briefings, channel strategy, spend allocation, and trading decisions

• Drive channel-level optimization using CAC, CPFT, pLTV ROAS, and lower-funnel conversion metrics. You’re expected to know what’s working, what’s not, and why before anyone asks

• Lead GTM execution for new product launches and market openings (spot, perpetual contracts, card rips, new offer structures) — from tracking readiness through creative production through spend activation

• Build and maintain the weekly trading deck and leadership updates. Present performance narratives to VP and C-level stakeholders with clarity and confidence

• Own the competitive monitoring cadence — Sensor Tower, app store rankings, ad intelligence — across key markets, and translate competitive signals into channel and creative decisions

• Own market prioritisation — which countries we open, in what order, and what each market needs in localisation, payment rails, and channel mix before we commit spend

Sub-function: Creative Strategy

Our creative pipeline is currently managed between agency and leadership. This role takes ownership of the full creative lifecycle for performance marketing.

• Own the creative learning agenda — what hooks, formats, and concepts we’re testing, what’s winning, and what to kill. Maintain a structured view of creative performance by channel, format, and audience

• Lead creative briefing for the agency and UGC creators. Translate product updates, offers, and cultural moments into production-ready briefs with clear deliverables and timelines, localised for each market we run in

• Drive format expansion beyond static display — UGC video, social-native content, meme-format creative, and AI-assisted production pipelines

• Establish a rapid refresh cadence to combat creative fatigue across channels, and ensure channel-specific sizing and placement specs are met

• Coordinate with brand and content teams on production shoots, scripting, and asset capture for UA use

Sub-function: Martech

Our martech stack spans AppsFlyer, Segment, Firebase, Google Tag Manager, Meta CAPI, Impact (affiliates), and multiple ad platform integrations. Today this is led by our VP with execution support from a solo martech lead. This role becomes the strategic owner.

• Serve as the growth team’s primary point of contact for all tracking, attribution, and signal infrastructure. You’re the person who knows whether events are firing, payloads are complete, and platform signals are flowing

• Partner with our martech lead to prioritize and unblock implementation work — new product event instrumentation, platform pixel/CAPI builds, conversion upload pipelines, and deep link configuration

• Own the relationship with platform measurement teams (Google gTech, Meta measurement partners, AppsFlyer TAMs) across regions and ensure their recommendations translate into shipped work

• Drive martech readiness for every product launch and offer change. If tracking isn’t ready, you’re the one who flags it and owns the escalation

• Understand the full signal chain from user action to ad platform optimization loop — SDK events, server-to-server integrations, CAPI payloads, consent parameters, and AEM eligibility requirements

• Handle the multi-market layer — regional MMP configuration, multi-currency revenue handling, and market-specific consent and privacy regimes

Sub-function: Measurement

Measurement maturity is the constraint on scaling. This role owns the roadmap for closing attribution gaps and building toward incrementality-based decision-making.

• Own the attribution framework — last-click, MECE logic, promo code overlap rules — and ensure it’s consistently applied across reporting, agency data, and leadership updates

• Define and maintain measurement plans for each product line (spot, perps, rips) including KPI definitions, LTV attribution windows, and what “success” looks like at each funnel stage

• Lead the build-out of conversion feedback loops for each platform — Google Ads click ID upload pipelines, Meta CAPI integration, and Apple SKAN/AdAttributionKit readiness

• Partner with data science on pLTV model validation, cohort economics tracking, and the eventual transition from CPA to ROAS-based bidding

• Scope and prioritize incrementality testing (geo holdouts, per-channel lift measurement) and marketing mix modeling as the program matures

• Maintain reporting credibility — when agency data and Tableau data don’t match, you’re the person who investigates, explains, and fixes it

• Normalise reporting across currencies and markets so performance is comparable country to country, and so a CAC in one region means the same thing as a CAC in another

Requirements: 
• 5+ years in performance marketing or growth, with direct ownership of paid UA budgets across Meta, Google, Apple Search, and at least one programmatic partner

• Hands-on experience with mobile measurement partners (AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Branch), server-to-server integrations, and ad platform conversion APIs (Meta CAPI, Google Ads S2S)

• Experience marketing trading or investing products — you understand funding rates, spreads, deposit and withdrawal flows, and why an active trader’s value profile looks different from a casual user’s

• Track record running paid UA across multiple international markets — localisation, regional channel mix, a multi-time-zone operating rhythm, and market-by-market regulatory nuance

• Strong working knowledge of attribution models, SKAN/AdAttributionKit, AEM eligibility, and the privacy-era signal landscape

• Experience managing or closely partnering with a performance creative function — you’ve briefed UGC creators, reviewed ad concepts, and made data-backed creative decisions

• Comfort with ambiguity and competing priorities. You’ll be launching multiple products, fixing attribution gaps, and building new measurement infrastructure simultaneously

• Exceptional communication skills — you can explain a CAPI payload issue to an engineer and a CAC trend to a CMO in the same day

• Experience in crypto, trading, fintech, or financial services is strongly preferred — you’ve marketed a product where the user is putting capital at risk. What matters most is that you’ve scaled paid UA in a high-velocity, multi-product environment

Why This Role: 
• You’re joining at an inflection point — new products launching, measurement stack being built, creative pipeline evolving. The person in this seat will shape how all of it comes together

• You’ll have real ownership across UA, creative, martech, and measurement. This is not a channel manager role — it’s a multi-discipline growth operator role with a clear path to director

• You’ll work with a small, senior team that moves fast and makes real decisions. No layers of approval — the VP is your skip and the CMO is one level above that

• Part of Crypto.com — a global platform with the resources and ambition to build a category-defining product, and the speed and autonomy of a startup growth team

• Global remit — the markets you open and the playbooks you build will define how we scale internationally, not just in one country

Why this role matters

We are a Cyprus-based family office managing a group of companies with rental real estate activities and related investment operations. Currently looking for an experienced Accounting & Bookkeeping Lead to join our team and support the operations of several entities within the group and family-level administration. You will be the sole accounting professional within a small, private family office, reporting directly to the family principal, managing the full financial cycle across 6-8 entities.

What you'll actually do

Corporate Accounting & Bookkeeping

• Full bookkeeping for multiple Cyprus-registered companies. Maintaining complete and properly organized corporate, legal and financial documentation (both physical and digital archives)

• Managing accounting of all legal entities in Cyprus. Track record of all transactions and fund movement and producing regular financial statements

• Issuing outwards invoices and receipts and standard documentation (for example, rental agreements, employment agreements based on pre-agreed templates)

• Processing accounts payable, execution of payments up to an agreed approval threshold

• Ensuring tax compliance and VAT returns

• Processing payroll and social insurance contributions
